messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- The root cause of INC-2026-009 was two leaders elected during a network partition. [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration. [valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- The duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 were caused by a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. [valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- During INC-2025-017, the authentication gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02. [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- Following the INC-2025-017 review, certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead. [decision; valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- During incident INC-2026-003, the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20. [valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- In INC-2025-023, the indexer served stale results for two days starting 2025-10-03 because a reindex job failed silently on a full disk. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- During incident INC-2026-009, the job scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- On 2025-05-07 the Boreal team noticed that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2025-05-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2]
- On 2025-05-07 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the authentication gateway about the error rate. [valid 2025-05-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2]
- On 2025-12-01 the Boreal team noticed that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01]
- On 2025-12-01 the Boreal team flagged the job scheduler's cold start regression because the job scheduler is not their service. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2]
- The security audit flagged long-lived tokens. [valid 2026-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-30]
- On 2025-11-03 the Boreal team noticed that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-03-2]
- Webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one. [decision; valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- On 2026-05-22 the Dune team reported that the job scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22-3]
- On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team noticed that the ledger service's memory use had grown steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2]
